dewow-wow-name.quote: Remove the low-frequency components (the so-called “wow”) of the GPR record

dewow-wow-origin.look: Ch. 5 (pp. 141–176), the part of the basic processing section on dewow (time-domain filtering of low-frequency 'wow').

dewow-usual-fix.look: Ch. 5 (pp. 141–176), the part of the basic processing section on dewow (time-domain filtering of low-frequency 'wow').

dewow-boxcar.quote: Because the boxcar function outlines its filter coefficients, it is called a boxcar filter.

dewow-low-pass.look: Moving average, lead section; Low-pass filter, lead section.
dewow-low-pass.quote: Moving average: “in signal processing it is viewed as a low-pass finite impulse response filter.” Low-pass filter: “Low-pass filters provide a smoother form of a signal, removing the short-term fluctuations and leaving the longer-term trend.”

dewow-high-pass.look: High-pass filter, lead section; Low-pass filter, lead section.
dewow-high-pass.quote: High-pass filter: “passes signals with a frequency higher than a certain cutoff frequency and attenuates signals with frequencies lower than the cutoff frequency.” Low-pass filter: “A low-pass filter is the complement of a high-pass filter.”

dewow-sinc.look: Sinc function, lead section; Moving average, section 'Simple moving average'.
dewow-sinc.quote: Sinc function: “The normalized sinc function is the Fourier transform of the rectangular function with no scaling.” Moving average: “Its frequency response is a type of low-pass filter called sinc-in-frequency (or, in discrete time, is a Dirichlet kernel).”

dewow-other-filters.quote: Remove the low-frequency components (the so-called “wow”) of the GPR record using: a running median filter (type = "runnmed") a running mean filter (type = "runmean") a Gaussian filter (type = "Gaussian")

dewow-passes-fast.quote: A major drawback of the SMA is that it lets through a significant amount of the signal shorter than the window length. This can lead to unexpected artifacts, such as peaks in the smoothed result appearing where there were troughs in the data.

dewow-dirichlet.quote: In signal processing, the Dirichlet kernel is often called the periodic sinc function … This kernel is also the Fourier Transform of a discrete time moving average filter.
